notes: Bambu Lab X1C, PLA, 0.4 mm nozzle. Validated 2026-11-12 with two fit coupons and a printed PLA Pin; press_shaft 0.00 was set after them and finalized without a third coupon.
Good on both coupons: 6805, 608 and 6801 bearing seats; dowel; M3 and M5 screw holes; M5 nut slot.
Bushing hole (press 0.10): needs a bit of pressure to insert; the pin still inserts well.
Planet pin hole: too tight at press_pin 0.10; tight but manageable at 0.20 (second coupon).
Output hex socket: slightly loose at hex_socket 0.25 on the resin Pin; fits well at 0.10 (second coupon).
Threaded-insert holes (Ø4.2 / Ø6.4): ruthex M3 and M5 heat-set well (second coupon).

Printed shafts: the Ø25 and Ø12 pegs and the PLA Pin journal were borderline loose in the 6805 and 6801 bores at press_shaft 0.10 on the first coupon and noticeably loose on the second, so press_shaft is 0.00 (the Fusion sizes). If printed shafts are still loose or too tight to press in, tune press_shaft first.
Heat-set the inserts with a soldering iron; press bushings and planet pins in square with a vise. A new printer, nozzle or filament needs a new coupon.
